title: give2
description: Give any item to any player, instantly. Browse all Minecraft items, search by name, customize enchantments, and target multiple players.
body:
![give2 Banner](https://i.imgur.com/hf3P6BJ.png) [![flowdev icon](https://i.imgur.com/VxbWl2C.png)](https://modrinth.com/organization/flowdev) [![flowdev plugin](https://i.imgur.com/YJa4JPV.png)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plug-in_(computing)) [![flowdev give2](https://i.imgur.com/s4BSBh7.png)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/give2)
## What is this?
**A complete, GUI-driven overhaul of the vanilla `/give` command!**
Tired of memorizing complex command syntax and typing out long NBT tags just to give someone an enchanted item? `give2` replaces the standard text command with a sleek, interactive menu. 
Simply type `/give2`, browse or search for your desired item, visually select and level up your enchantments, and send it directly to your target with a few quick clicks. No command blocks or wikis required!
 
---
 
## How to use
 
1. Run `/give2 <player>` — the item GUI will open
2. Browse or search for the item you want
3. Click an item to open the enchantment screen
4. Left click an enchantment to select it (level 1)
5. Right click to cycle through levels
6. Click **Give** to send the item to the target(s)
 
---

## Configuration
 
```yaml
# If true, only OPs can use /give2
# If false, everyone can use /give2
ONLY_OPS: true
```
 
## Requirements
 
- 1.21.x+
- Java 21+
 
---
 
## Installation
 
1. Download the latest `.jar` from the releases page
2. Drop it into your server's `plugins/` folder
3. Restart the server
4. Edit `plugins/give2/config.yml` if needed
